overall_reason: The content is specific and human (Harbor and Co, the revised PO, 'A short note beats another status meeting') but the skin is a stock Tailwind-slate dashboard: three equal unsourced stat cards, segmented pills, blue-600 accent, mono display face on a non-code page and side-stripe accents, with the action section left invisible by a scroll-reveal.

findings.evidence: Failed T-DEFAULT-AGENT and T-MIRROR: 'internal ops dashboard' yields exactly this first screen: a row of three equal white cards ('Open threads 128', 'Waiting on us 14', 'Pipeline $42.6k'), segmented filter pills, a bordered table with a tinted header, on #F8FAFC with #3B82F6/#1E293B tokens (sweep stock_swatches).
findings.before: Three equal KPI cards + pill filters + slate palette
findings.after: Lead with the one thing the weekly ops reader acts on (the Urgent table) and fold the three counts into its header line, e.g. 'Urgent · 3 of 128 open threads · $42.6k pipeline'
findings.why: The skeleton is the default dashboard kit; only the copy is Northline's.

findings.where: Urgent table row 'Harbor and Co' and insight callout, tiles 00-01
findings.evidence: A 3px red left border marks the flagged table row and a 4px orange left border frames the note "Harbor has gone quiet after the price change...".
findings.before: Side-tab accent borders on row and callout
findings.after: Let the 'Blocked' status carry the row; set the note as a plain paragraph under a small heading 'Suggested next step'
findings.why: One-side accent stripes are a stock emphasis device (SLP-004).

findings.evidence: h1 'Northline weekly ops' and section labels 'Urgent 3 threads', 'Pending 3 items' are set in Fira Code, a monospace face, on an ops page with no code; body in Fira Sans.
findings.before: Monospace display face for prose headings
findings.after: Set headings in Fira Sans semibold; keep mono for figures in the Amount and Change columns only
findings.why: Mono-as-personality on non-code labels is a look-family tell (dark-single-accent / hairline-newspaper 'mono_labels').

findings.evidence: A 329px empty band follows 'How this note was chosen'; dom shows the 'Empty' state and the 'Reach them' section (Telegram, Text the plant, Send follow-up, Snooze) at opacity 0. hidden.json: 114 characters stay invisible unless reduced motion is on.
findings.before: Scroll-reveal leaves the action section invisible
findings.after: Render sections visible by default; animate from visible (opacity .001 -> 1 only when JS and IntersectionObserver are confirmed)
findings.why: The page's call to action ('Send follow-up') never appears: decoration over function.

strengths: Copy is concrete and only-this-business: 'Ask Harbor for the revised PO before Friday', 'Intro sent to the Boston plant manager', 'Harbor has gone quiet after the price change. A short note beats another status meeting.'
Status column pairs icon, colour and word (Blocked / Waiting / Clear) with a secondary reason ('Stale 9 days'): a real decision, keep it.
Numbers are tabular and right-aligned in the Amount column.
not_investigated: No 00-contract.md; the page says it is styled by a named skill's design system, so palette choices are judged as unchosen defaults, not brand.
The before/after comparison page was not opened.
